verdict.rationale: Vercel documents a REST API and SDK for programmatic account access, backed by a published OpenAPI spec and token auth. A CLI, which can also run from automated systems, covers logs, certificates, DNS and more. Some settings, such as function regions, are documented as configurable from both the dashboard and code or CLI. However, no evidence claims or demonstrates that every UI action has an API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, an endpoint inventory mapped against dashboard features, and independent confirmation that no UI-only operations exist.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Interact programmatically with your Vercel account using the SDK or direct HTTP requests.
Vercel access tokens authenticate requests to the Vercel REST API and the Vercel CLI on your behalf.
you can interact with the Vercel platform using a terminal, or through an automated system
Regions can be set in the dashboard, in vercel.json via the regions key
